title: Heating & cooling
summary: Furnaces, heat pumps, mini-splits and the tune-up that stops February emergencies.
price: Diagnostic $89, waived if we do the work
response: Same day for no heat or no cool
imageAlt: A newly installed wall-mounted air conditioning unit in a sunlit living room
description: Furnace and heat-pump repair, replacement and maintenance in Wrenfield and the surrounding towns — same-day when the house has no heat.
content:
Heat is the call we get most, and it almost always comes at the worst hour. We carry the common igniters, capacitors and control boards on the van, so roughly four out of five no-heat calls are finished on the first visit.

What we handle

  • Furnace and boiler repair, replacement and annual service
  • Heat pumps and ductless mini-split installation
  • Air-conditioning repair, recharge and replacement
  • Thermostats, zoning and duct sealing

How the visit goes

We measure before we quote — static pressure, temperature split and the age of the equipment — and then give you the repair price and the replacement price side by side. If the honest answer is that the unit has two good winters left, we will say so.

title: Plumbing
summary: Leaks, water heaters, fixtures and re-pipes — found quickly and left dry.
price: Flat-rate quote before any work starts
response: Emergency calls answered around the clock
imageAlt: Neat new copper and chrome pipework under a bright kitchen sink
description: Leak detection, water heaters, fixture replacement and whole-house re-pipes, with a flat-rate quote before the first wrench turns.
content:
A leak costs more the longer it runs, so we find the source before we open a wall — moisture meters and a camera first, drywall second. You approve a flat price before anything is cut.

What we handle

  • Leak detection and pipe repair
  • Water heaters, tank and tankless
  • Faucets, toilets, disposals and fixture swaps
  • Whole-house re-pipes in copper or PEX

How the visit goes

We put down floor protection on the way in and take it up on the way out. Every joint we open gets tested under pressure before we call the job finished, and the old parts stay on the counter so you can see what failed.

title: Electrical
summary: Panels, outlets, lighting and the tripping breaker nobody has explained yet.
price: Diagnostic $89, waived if we do the work
response: Most work booked within two days
imageAlt: An open electrical panel with tidy labelled breakers on a bright garage wall
description: Panel upgrades, circuits, outlets and lighting by licensed electricians — permits pulled and inspections handled.
content:
Electrical work is the one trade where the cheap fix is genuinely dangerous, so everything we touch is done to code, permitted where the town requires it, and labelled when we leave.

What we handle

  • Panel upgrades and service changes
  • New circuits, outlets, switches and EV chargers
  • Interior, exterior and landscape lighting
  • Whole-house safety inspections

How the visit goes

We start at the panel, because a breaker that keeps tripping is usually telling the truth about something further down the line. You get a written finding for anything we recommend, with the code reference, not just a price.

title: Repairs & handyman
summary: The list on the fridge — doors, drywall, decks, mounting and the rest of it.
price: Booked by the half day or the whole day
imageAlt: A carpenter fitting a new pale oak cabinet door in a bright kitchen
description: Half-day and full-day handyman visits for the list of small jobs — doors, drywall, decks, mounting and trim.
content:
Most of these jobs are too small for a contractor and too fiddly for a Saturday. Book a half day and we will work down the list in the order you care about.

What we handle

  • Doors that stick, latch badly or hang crooked
  • Drywall patching, trim, caulking and touch-up paint
  • Deck boards, railings, gates and fence panels
  • Shelving, TV mounting, blinds and cabinet hardware

How the visit goes

Send the list when you book, with photos if you have them. We will tell you honestly what fits in the time and what needs its own visit, and we sweep up before we go.

title: Water heaters
summary: Repair, replacement and the tankless conversion, usually finished the same day.
imageAlt: Neat new copper and chrome pipework under a bright kitchen sink
description: Water-heater repair, same-day replacement and tankless conversions, with the old unit hauled away.
content:
A cold shower is a same-day problem. We stock the common tank sizes and can usually swap a failed heater the day you call, including hauling the old one away.

What we handle

  • Tank repair — thermocouples, elements, valves and anodes
  • Same-day tank replacement in 40, 50 and 75 gallon
  • Tankless installation and annual descaling
  • Expansion tanks, pans and recirculation loops

How the visit goes

We check the venting and the gas or electrical supply before we quote, because a heater that keeps failing is often a venting problem wearing a heater costume.

title: Drains & sewer
summary: Clearing, camera inspection and the root problem under the front lawn.
price: Drain clearing from $159 with a camera check
response: Same day for a backed-up main
imageAlt: Neat new copper and chrome pipework under a bright kitchen sink
description: Drain clearing, camera inspection and sewer-line repair — including the roots most older streets are hiding.
content:
A drain that clogs twice in a year is not a clog, it is a slope or a root. We clear the line, then put a camera down it so you can see the actual cause on the screen with us.

What we handle

  • Kitchen, bath and laundry drain clearing
  • Main-line clearing and root cutting
  • Camera inspection with a recording you keep
  • Spot repairs and full sewer-line replacement

How the visit goes

The camera pass is included whenever we clear a main. If the line is sound we will tell you that and charge you for the clearing only.
